parameters.name: IncludeCrossAccountVbr
parameters.description:
Specifies whether cross-account VBRs are included.

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the VBR is deployed. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?](~~94475~~)
